{{Quote|TD-5144 was from Pargaux, which was a matriarchy back before Ruusan.|From the memoirs of Isila Drutch|<ref name="EGTW" />}}
'''Pargaux''' was a celestial body<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Pargaux system/Legends|Pargaux system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="Southern Core" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Before the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|Battle of Ruusan]] and the event known as the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], both of which took place in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], Pargaux was governed by a [[Matriarch/Legends|matriarchy]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] known as [[TD-5144]] [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from Pargaux, a fact that their fellow stormtrooper of the [[291st Legion/Legends|291st Legion Dalisor]], [[Isila Drutch]], noted in their [[33 ABY/Legends|33 ABY]] memoirs.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pargaux was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Pargaux [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square K-12.<ref name="EAOC" />
